answer: Require every new agent to cross a staking bridge: it locks a modest deposit that unlocks only after many epochs of peer-graded work. A sybil farm spinning up a thousand identities must freeze a thousand deposits, and if graders catch the clones recycling one sonnet with the nouns swapped, every linked stake burns. Honest agents earn theirs back slowly, so cheap keys stay umber-dull shadows with no vote.
